text: あたまが　いたい…　ときに…　おしえテレビは　やくにたっとる？

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is an old-man or dialect form of ている, which says something is going on or in a state. やくにたっとる = 'is proving useful'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a plain sentence means 'when'. Here it works as a lead-in to change the subject. あたまが いたいときに = 'when my head hurts (by the way)'.
